maintenance_led.reason: Hotel REIT earning room revenue from guests at owned Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt and IHG-branded hotels, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from private business and leisure travelers paying for hotel rooms, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Owns a portfolio of hotels; growth is from operations and occasional acquisitions or dispositions, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Hotel guests can easily choose other hotels; branded rooms are a substitutable lodging service.
